method: Each name was confirmed from the cited source. Coordinates come from the US Census geocoder (sourced listing or office addresses), City of Goodyear HOA GIS extents, Maricopa County Assessor subdivision plat extents, Wikipedia, or a builder map pin, then tested with shapely against service_area.geojson. "inside" = point inside that part's sub-polygon, except Citrus entries flagged as being in the service-area strip between Verrado Way and Perryville Rd, which the brief groups with Citrus. "where" cross streets are read from the street grid around the tested coordinates/extents (Verrado Way -112.496, Jackrabbit Trl -112.479, Perryville Rd -112.461, Citrus Rd -112.444, Cotton Ln -112.427, Litchfield Rd -112.358; Indian School Rd 33.494, Camelback Rd 33.508, Bethany Home Rd 33.523, Northern Ave 33.552).

bbb.name: BBB Mountain West & Pacific Southwest
bbb.office: 1010 E. Missouri Avenue, Phoenix, AZ 85014-4585 (Phoenix hub)
bbb.fee_note: No dollar amount published. BBB.org says only "Accredited businesses pay an annual dues investment." The interest form asks whether the business has operated more than six months, then the local BBB contacts you. Formed in 2026 when BBB Mountain West and BBB Pacific Southwest merged (AZ, CA, NV, UT).

other_listings.why: Professional & Personal Services: $25 application + $40/yr. There is also a Solid Waste Hauler class ($40 + $410/yr); ask the city which one applies to dog waste pickup.

other_listings.name: Maricopa County licenses and permits
